SELECT t.custcd AS CUSTCD, c.custname AS CUSTNAME, c.sabunnm AS SABUNNM, SUM(t.amt) AS AMT, SUM(t.banpum) AS BANPUM, (SUM(t.amt) - SUM(t.banpum)) AS MCAMT, SUM(t.cash) AS SKAMT, SUM(t.sale) AS SALEAMT, (SUM(t.amt) - SUM(t.banpum) - SUM(t.inamt)) AS PROFIT, SUM(ISNULL(k.janamt, 0) + t.amt - t.banpum - t.cash - t.sale) AS JANAMT FROM ( SELECT custcd, gubun, SUM(amt) amt, SUM(banpum) banpum, SUM(inamt) inamt, 0 cash, 0 sale FROM mc20_mst WHERE buseo = '0001' AND gubun = '매출' AND cdate BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY custcd, gubun
UNION ALL
SELECT custcd, kjskgu, 0, 0, 0, SUM(cashamt), SUM(saleamt) FROM kjsk_mst WHERE buseo = '0001' AND kjskdate BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND kjskgu = '수금' GROUP BY buseo, kjskgu, custcd ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN kjsk_tb k ON k.custcd = t.custcd AND k.buseo = '0001' AND k.YYMM = DATEFORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(#{fromDate} AS DATE)), 'YYYYMM') LEFT OUTER JOIN cust_mst c ON c.custcd = t.custcd
AND c.sabunnm LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
AND c.custname LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
GROUP BY t.custcd, c.custname, c.sabunnm ORDER BY c.sabunnm, c.custname
